title: AE40029: Random Vibration In Aerospace Engineering
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: AE21004, AE31002, AE31005
3 - 0 - 0: 3 CreditsIntroduction
to probability theory, random variables, random processes, response of a system
to random excitation: linear discrete, linear continuous and non-linear
discrete and continuous systems, response of a random system to deterministic
and random excitation, failure to random vibrations, application to aerospace
structures.
